end.summary:
Identified standing, sleeping and slanting straight lines across 8 attempts; this was shown on new examples and why questions.
Practised telling straight lines from curved lines; easy examples were answered correctly, with a why or new-situation check next time.
Used examples such as a flag, pencil, bangle, letters, table and kite string.
A brief mix-up naming the lines in T, H and A was corrected during turns 5–6; later examples included L and the kite string.
end.parentNote: Om practised standing, sleeping and slanting lines using familiar objects and letters. They identified the line types across new examples and corrected a brief mix-up with T, H and A during the lesson. Telling straight from curved lines was practised with easy examples; next time, ask Om to explain why a new line is straight or curved. At home, draw a few lines and ask Om to name each one and give an everyday example.
